title: IMCD N.V.
content:
IMCD is a global specialty chemicals distributor headquartered in the Netherlands. In the aerogel segment, the company has distributed aerogel materials in Nordic and Baltic markets while supporting customers through technical sales and formulation expertise.

  • Coverage Area: Nordic and Baltic countries, with wider European reach
  • Focus Areas: Specialty chemical distribution, aerogel powders for industrial applications, and formulation support
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://www.imcdgroup.com/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
